description: Get exchange rates for one base currency in a single snapshot, with provenance and the actual rate date. Omit symbols for the market snapshot’s available quote codes. Explicit legacy bases and symbols use statutory factors from euro adoption. Listing the base in symbols returns a rate of 1 for it.

base_currency.description: ISO 4217 base currency code (e.g. USD). Call fx_list_currencies to get valid codes.

date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for the latest available rate. Frankfurter v1 data starts 1999-01-04; fixed-only rates start at euro adoption. Future dates are not supported.

symbols.description: Optional list of quote currency codes to filter the response. When provided, must contain at least one currency code — omit the field entirely, not an empty array, to return all ~30 supported currencies (the base is not among them). Including base_currency here is valid — it comes back with a rate of 1.

items.description: ISO 4217 currency code to include in the response.

name: fx_get_rates

date_snapped.description: True when Frankfurter v1 served a prior publication date because the requested daily fix was unavailable. False for fixed-only and latest results.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_date_format`: date is not a real calendar date written as YYYY-MM-DD. `unsupported_currency`: base_currency or an entry in symbols is not available in the current discovery or served historical data. `date_out_of_range`: date is in the future or precedes 1999-01-04 without an applicable fixed-only rate. `upstream_no_data`: Every requested currency is supported but Frankfurter v1 has no observation for a requested currency on this date. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

fixed_rate_date.description: Date the statutory factors were applied, when different from the served market rate_date.

fixed_rates.description: Statutory factors used in the result, present only when a fixed leg was used.

adoption_date.description: First date the statutory factor applies (YYYY-MM-DD).

units_per_eur.description: Statutory units of this currency per EUR.

notice.description: Discloses restated units for historical RON or TRY rates.

rate_date.description: Served market publication date, or the requested date (current UTC date for latest) for a fixed-only result.

rate_type.description: Identifies Frankfurter v1 reference rates, statutory euro conversion, or a combination.

rates.description: Map of quote currency code → exchange rate (units of quote per 1 base).

source.description: Source of the factors used in this result.

title: Fx Get Rates
